s.n: Charred pineapple salsa with lime chips
s.how: Cut half a pineapple into thick slices and char on a very hot grill pan for 3 minutes a side. Cool and dice. Mix with half a finely diced red onion, 1 chopped jalapeño, a handful of chopped coriander, the juice of 2 limes and salt. Rest 10 minutes. Toss 250g corn chips with the zest of 1 lime and half a tsp salt and serve with the salsa.

Heat the oven to 190C. Cut a cob loaf in a crosshatch pattern, 2cm apart, without cutting through the base. Melt 100g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and 2 tbsp chopped parsley. Spoon into all the cuts, then stuff with 200g grated mozzarella and 40g parmesan. Wrap in foil and bake 15 minutes, then unwrap and bake 10 minutes until golden and melted.

m.note: Red, the middleman who keeps getting back up
m.how: Simmer 100ml soy, 60ml mirin, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp grated ginger and 1 garlic clove for 5 minutes until syrupy. Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in half the sauce for 30 minutes. Grill on a hot barbecue for 5 to 6 minutes a side, brushing with more sauce. Grill 8 pineapple slices 2 minutes a side. Cook 1.5 cups rice. Slice the chicken and serve with pineapple, sesame, spring onion and sliced chilli in vinegar.

w.note: Dale's dinner from hell with Angie's parents
w.how: Heat the oven to 180C. Melt 60g butter with 100g brown sugar and 2 tbsp dark rum in a 23cm tin and lay 8 fresh pineapple rings on top. Beat 125g butter with 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs, then 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Spread over the fruit and bake 45 minutes. Rest 5 minutes and turn out. Serve warm with 200ml chilled coconut cream.

d.how: Mix 1 tbsp salt with half a tsp chilli powder and rim 4 glasses. For each drink, muddle 4 pineapple chunks, 4 mint leaves, 15ml brown sugar syrup and 20ml lime juice in a shaker. Add 45ml white rum and 60ml pineapple juice, shake with ice and pour over crushed ice. For non-drinkers, skip the rum and top with soda.
